svg.aria-label: Time-lapse of a desktop conversation in which the Lead drives three lgtmgate runs in parallel, next to a background tasks panel that groups the agents of the run being discussed under its phases. The user sends /lgtmgate:deliver 142 and asks for #187 and #203 in parallel. On #142 the review asks for one fix, the dev agent makes it and the second review passes. #203 passes its review, then stops: a fix on main changed the same lines. The Lead keeps both changes, merges main into the pull request, re-runs the tests and relaunches the review alone. All three pull requests end ready and the Lead asks before merging. Once the user says yes, the Lead replies that every box is checked and merges them. Durations and agent counts are illustrative.

text.tspan: Three runs launched, each in its own worktree.
#142: review wants one fix. Dev agent on it.
#203 stopped: its PR conflicts with main.
Main fixed the same lines. Keeping both.
Merged main, tests pass. Relaunching review.
Every box is checked. Merging all three PRs.
